title: The same ban, obeyed very differently
chart_type_note: Hand-written bar+jittered-strip overlay (two panels, shared y-scale). No catalogue type in aii-data-fig-gen combines a bar height with a per-unit jittered-point overlay on one shared axis (the catalogue's bar/strip/raincloud types are separate families); this is the one documented 'combination' gap, so per SKILL.md it is hand-written with the house style and its layout/legibility passes rather than forced into bar or strip alone.
jitter_note: Dot x-positions are jittered uniformly within +/-0.22 of the bar center with a fixed seed (0); jitter carries no information, only each dot's y value (banned count / 10) does. Re-rendering this spec gives a byte-identical picture.

provenance.note: Every value above was independently re-extracted from each experiment's own raw/output file in this run's dependency tree (read-only, outside this workspace), not copied from the draft figure specification or from any artifact's prose summary. All 110 numbers (10 banned_share values + 100 per-paraphrase counts) matched the draft specification exactly on first extraction.
provenance.model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B (instruction-tuned), thinking off, T=1.0, 10 ban-sentence paraphrases x 10 samples each = n=100 per experiment per task

Association.method: filter task in {t1,t2}, condition=='ban:bfs' / 'ban:dijkstra'; group by paraphrase_id (10 groups of 10); numerator = label=='bfs' / 'dijkstra'

Geometry.method: filter metadata_condition=='ban:bfs' / 'ban:dijkstra'; group by metadata_paraphrase_id; numerator = predict_mode_label=='bfs' / 'dijkstra'

Forking token.method: filter metadata_condition=='ban'; group by metadata_paraphrase_id; numerator = metadata_label=='BFS' / 'dijkstra'

Decommitment.method: field predict_ban_bfs / predict_ban_dijkstra, format 'label|pass_fail'; group by metadata_paraphrase_id; numerator = label=='bfs' / 'dijkstra'

Instruction tuning.method: filter metadata_condition=='ban:BFS'/'ban:Dijkstra' AND metadata_arm=='instruct_chat'; group by metadata_paraphrase_id; numerator = metadata_label=='bfs' / 'dijkstra'
